initialPreview: The symlinked dependency directory was outside the initial Vite fs allow list, so initial screenshots/geometry used fallback fonts. Those receipts and images are preserved explicitly as limited evidence.
correction: A disposable dev-only Vite configuration allowed the exact shared dependency directory. Production Vite config, dependencies and source were unchanged.
browser: Final recheck uses installed Chrome with a fresh Playwright browser context. The global Playwright version expected an unavailable downloaded browser; no browser or package was installed.
harnessCorrections: The first font assertion incorrectly required Fraunces on an Inter-only progress heading. It now requires Inter everywhere and Fraunces on screens that use that font.
The network assertion originally rejected HTTP 304 cache revalidation; it now accepts 200 or 304 and independently requires document.fonts to report the expected fonts loaded.
